newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate flat at 48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate flat at 48 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week funds stayed unchanged at 48 percent at this week's refinancing auction.

On Thursday, the central bank cut its one-week minimum permitted rate by two percentage points to 48 percent. It also increased the funds available to 1.18 trillion lei from a previous 1.045 trillion.
The central bank's offer was undersubscribed by three commercial banks which entered 1.150 trillion lei worth of bids at prices equal with the minimum permitted rate.
